source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
display_title: RESIST II Process Innovation Open Call – RESIST II
call_title: RESIST II Process Innovation Open Call
executive_summary: Cascade call issued by the RESIST II Eurocluster project, funded by the EU Single Market Programme. It funds SMEs from the EU and SMP countries that are active in the mobility, transport and automotive ecosystem (automotive, rail, waterborne, cycling) to improve their manufacturing or industrial processes so that they become more digital, green and resilient, alone or in consortia of up to three SMEs from different NUTS2 regions. Lump-sum grants of up to EUR 20,000 for individual projects and EUR 30,000 per SME in collaborative projects, with at least 10% private co-financing; the total call budget is EUR 800,000 over two cut-offs. The first cut-off closed on 13 July 2026; the second cut-off is expected to open in May 2027, with no deadline yet published by the project. Projects last up to 9 months.
status_rationale: The call funds process innovation in the manufacturing and industrial operations of SMEs in the mobility, transport and automotive ecosystem, such as electrified process heat, battery recycling processes and AI-based factory optimisation (Guide for Applicants, Process Innovation, 2.2 Objectives and scope and 2.4 Who can apply). It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close, the beneficiaries and results stay inside automotive and transport manufacturing, and the call addresses neither the grid, electricity markets nor flexibility for system operation.
